description: A round of asking for gift ideas about the caller's pick, without naming the caller.

participantEmail.description: The caller's email address. Overwritten with the signed-in address, so naming somebody else does nothing.

hatId.description: The gift exchange, which the caller must be taking part in.

participantIds.description: Who to ask. Each is checked against the exchange; anybody not in it is dropped.

question.description: Optional, and sent to everybody asked. May not contain the caller's name or a link.
